route_task: SlotSPE / SPE-08 / official score and checkpoint selection source review

completed_work.selection_metric: validation concordance_index_censored; not training loss or validation loss
completed_work.selection_rule: Every epoch is evaluated; if val_cindex >= args.max_cindex, update max and overwrite the fold best checkpoint and best prediction file.
completed_work.ties: A later equal-scoring epoch replaces the saved best checkpoint.
completed_work.summary_csv_val_cindex: The maximum single validation C-index observed across epochs for each fold (args.max_cindex), not the last epoch and not the re-evaluated best-checkpoint C-index.
completed_work.summary_csv_mean: Arithmetic mean of the available fold maxima. With default k=5 and all folds run, mean of five fold maxima; each fold may choose a different epoch.
completed_work.fold_split: Uses train and val. A variable named test_data is instantiated with split_key=val; the score-selection code does not show a separate untouched outer test set.
completed_work.risk_definition: sigmoid(logits) -> cumulative product of (1-hazards) -> risk = negative sum of survival across time bins

checkpoint_and_prediction_files.model_best_s{fold}.pth: Best validation epoch checkpoint; overwritten on >=.
checkpoint_and_prediction_files.split_{fold}_results.pkl: Predictions saved at the best validation epoch.
checkpoint_and_prediction_files.split_{fold}_results_final.pkl: The results_dict returned from the final-weight evaluation before best checkpoint reload, despite the main CSV C-index being the historical maximum.

best_checkpoint_reevaluation.other_returned_metrics: IPCW C-index, Brier metrics, iauc and val_loss use the best-checkpoint re-evaluation.
best_checkpoint_reevaluation.randomness_caveat: Native Gaussian slot draws and Gumbel selection persist in eval; the recomputed score need not equal the saved historical maximum. The _summary function contains no 20-repeat averaging.

completed_work.launch_script_scope: Example launcher runs separate seed-specific jobs and passes --omic_missing. Its seed list does not by itself establish the aggregation used in paper tables.
completed_work.current_local_diagnostic_protocol_compar: Current documented diagnostic queue uses 3 epochs, 256 real patches, fixed final-epoch weights and 20 repeated evaluations. That is a different score-selection/budget protocol from official 30-epoch validation-peak scoring.

gaps_reasons: This confirms behavior of the fixed official public source snapshot, not which artifacts were used for every published paper-table value. Paper table provenance needs the matching configs/logs/checkpoints. A validation-selected peak is not an independently tested generalization result.
next_action_user_input: No patient execution is needed to answer this source question. Any score comparison must state the epoch selection rule, fold/split, training budget, patch count, seed and evaluation repetitions; do not equate the current short final-checkpoint audit with official validation-peak scores.
